newsitem.title: USA: R.G. Barry sees record revenues in 1997.
newsitem.headline: R.G. Barry sees record revenues in 1997.

text.p: R.G. Barry Corp said Monday that solid bookings so far this year incicate the company will show record earnings in 1997.
"We are on target for our 1997 plan and expect to see another record year. Comfort footwear bookings are ahead of the same period last year," said Gordon Zacks, president and chief executive officer.
Speaking at the company's annual shareholders' meeting, Zacks said last year's milestones included a 31.1 percent jump in net earnings and designation by Wal-Mart as Footwear Vendor of the Year.
